notes.title: Southeast Asian Games Showcase featuring Midwest 90: Rapid City
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/9c1636a4875980e223e6fef84c47d4cd29a6adeb.png"][/img]
Hi Restaurateurs!

Midwest 90: rapid City will be part of the Southeast Asian Games Showcase on June 6-June 11!

If this comes as a surprise - yes, we are a Southeast Asian game development studio. 

If you are wondering why a Southeast Asian indie studio is making a game about the Midwest, well here's a video of Kesh talking about it to Kotatv back in 2021! :

https://www.kotatv.com/2021/04/30/midwest-meets-malaysia-in-rapid-city-inspired-video-game/?fbclid=IwAR3I2y5_MMRbGy2n75AYRk7JYYh7e9Bccf5nMv07YRfcyFOv6aJrlj1Ya4w

Yup.. we've been working on the game for a while now... but we're getting close to finishing! 

The Halloween 24 Playtest confirmed we have a solid gameplay loop and people love the world we are building! ( Thanks again for all the feedback! We heart you! )

So do check out the Southeast Asian Games Showcase, you will find so many gems there.


Have fun and thanks to the @seagameshowcase team![/p]

notes.title: Thank You For All The Great Feedback!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/5eb0fa9bb75e7afbfea939af7318d70f1efe69ce.png[/img]


Hi Restaurateurs! 

The team at Hidden Chest Studios would like to thank everyone who shared their feedback with us from the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest – it has been truly insightful and motivating. 

There have been over 800 downloads, far more than we anticipated! For that we must give special thanks to the following Youtubers for introducing the Midwest 90: Rapid City playtest to everyone: 

•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheGeekCupboard]The Geek Cupboard[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@orbitalpotato]Orbital Potato[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DanFieldGaming]Dan Field[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DieselDesigns]Diesel Design Gaming[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@floppysims]Floppy Sims[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@PlayfulPlaytests]Playful Playtests[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@hawk1377]Hawksu[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@shirlierox]Shirlierox[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@VividGamingGG]Vivid Gaming GG[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DadsGamingAddiction]Dad's Gaming Addiction[/url]

We are humbled by all the positivity and enthusiasm we received from the Playtest. Your support means everything to us, and we will do our very best to deliver an amazing new experience with Midwest 90: Rapid City.

As a side note, you might have noticed our Halloween ’24 Open Playtest is still available.

You also might have noticed that we haven’t updated our Playtest since, well, November 2024. 

Our previous announcement had informed that Patch 3 was the last for the playtest, and there’s a good reason for that – it’s just a Playtest and not an Early Access build with a live road map. 

The objective for the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest was to collect feedback for us to learn how to make a better game.

It wasn’t meant to be a representation of the final product.

However that being said, we are keeping this version of the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest available for download until further notice. This is for curious gamers who want to have a sneak peek at what we’re working towards. So please share this steam page with you friends!

We are now working towards our next development milestone – a Steam Next Fest demo and we couldn’t have come this far it without your contribution. 

Thanks again and Stay Hungry for the next update!

p.s Thanks for the Wishlists too!

notes.title: Patch 3 is LIVE - Halloween '24 Open Playtest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/78f8d04ee3a8ea7c26c59da005294e69f1aa4c6f.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

As the title informs, Patch 3 for the Halloween '24 Open Playtest is now live.

We have addressed all the save/load issues we could find, and the issues below:

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed "Gone Home" employees not returning when loading a save file
[/list]
Incursion:
[list]
[*]Fixed monsters spawning at paths that do not lead to the Restaurant
[*]Fixed doors automatically opening after an Incursion
[*]Fixed customers not spawning after an Incursion
[*]Fixed “Gone Home” employees returning after an incursion
[*]Fixed double the meat gain from Incursions
[/list]

Tooltips:
[list]
[*]Fixed tooltip information for Dishes And Profits showing total data rather than data at that time
[*]Fixed Town Welfare tooltip about Restaurant’s popularity effect on Town Welfare being inaccurate
[*]Fixed Finance graph duration buttons displaying incorrect tooltips
[/list]

Employees:
[list]
[*]Fixed employees walking through furniture after returning from the end of the first day
[*]Fixed cooks not immediately taking over another cook’s task
[/list]

Customers:
[list]
[*]Fixed customer potentially sitting on another customer
[*]Fixed customers continuing their eating animation after a Combo meal
[/list]

Management Screen:
[list]
[*]Fixed Finance Breakdown remaining open when returning to Restaurant Management
[*]Fixed Liberty Fund scroll getting stuck
[/list]

Incursion Alert:
[list]
[*]Fixed Incursion Alert popping up after Prawnzilla dies
[*]Fixed Incursion Alert not displaying correct data when sequence is broken
[*]Fixed Simulator displaying wrong incursion date
[/list]

Based on the feedback we received; we also have made the following Updates:

Simulation:
[list]
[*]Spawn zone information will remain open
[*]Restricting access to Incursion Details
[*]Disabling v-sync option
[/list]

Improve Staff Dish Trait: 
[list]
[*]Will now trigger upon Order Received
[*]Value is now +2 motivation
[/list]

Karen:
[list]
[*]Updated membership dialogue
[*]Introducing a discount on July 1
[/list]

Mr.X: 
[list]
[*]Progress Report now ends on July 17th
[*]Player’s evaluation changed
[/list]

Others:
[list]
[*]Added an SFX for Golden Tips.
[*]Now unable to build in the door frame connecting to the kitchen area.
[*]Changed Wallace dialogue about Missourite.
[*]Background of Policies scrollbar has been darkened
[*]Various tooltips
[*]Various item descriptions
[*]Added a “SCROLL DOWN” label in the Liberty Page
[*]Small Town Welfare newspaper sprite
[*]Popularity standee sprite
[/list]

This is our last planned update for this playtest session. We might have more patches depending on the feedback we received but so far we feel we are getting the responses we were hoping for. 

We still havent determined when this playtest is going to be closed, we will make announcement when we are ready. 

Do join us on our Discord channel if you liked our playtest demo and join the conversation to make Midwest 90: Rapid City a truly special game: discord.gg/n9RZtQNyBG

Thank you so much for the support, this playtest has been a blast for us.

Hidden Chest Studios

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/78f8d04ee3a8ea7c26c59da005294e69f1aa4c6f.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

Patch 2 is Live!

**IMPORTANT** 

There is a rare bug that we are still trying to figure out. 
If in-game time stops at 5:59pm for you, running the traps simulation will fix it.

**END**

Sorry for not announcing patch 1 and the delay for patch 2, we had our hands full and as I mentioned before, we are a tiny team who are dedicated to making a great experience.. but we need to improve our communications :(

Moving forward we'll do our best to improve. Please bear with us for now.

Finger crossed and looking forward to your feedback!

Hidden Chest Team

notes.title: Midwest 90: Rapid City - Halloween '24 Open Playtest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/78f8d04ee3a8ea7c26c59da005294e69f1aa4c6f.png[/img]

Happy Halloween!

It's been a while since we have had an open playtest for Midwest 90: Rapid City, over a year actually.

We're a tiny team who faced a lot of challenges throughout the year but we kept going and we'll keep going until M90 is ready.

We wish could have made this announcement sooner, we released the playtest on the 24th of October and haven't set an end date for the playtest but we have this patch schedule that you can refer to for the moment.

We still have a lot to do for the game but with your feedback we can finally move out of the alpha stage and aim for the finish line.

Thanks for all the support, we are 2230 wishlist and we hope we can grow that in the next few months so that we can secure some financial help from either a publisher or an investor.

Finger crossed and looking forward to your feedback!

Thanks again

Hidden Chest Team

notes.title: Free Alpha Demo Available For Download
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558145/aa924b0aa50260df5fb5bc7434dd862e3b90d7de.png[/img]

Hello Restaurant Tycoons and Base Builders!

My name is Kesh and I am the Game Director for Midwest 90: Rapid City and this is our first community update on Steam! 

It's a big deal for us, as we always shied away from drawing attention on Steam because we just didn't feel ready to show off Midwest 90: Rapid City (M90RC).

But thanks to the Level Up KL 2023 Games Showcase featuring M90RC, we have decided to take the plunge and make a free alpha demo available to download for the duration of the showcase ( 31st August - 15th Oct 2023 ).

After the event, we will take down the alpha demo because it doesn't fully represent the final game yet. But if you enjoyed our demo, we encourage you to stay tuned for further updates from us here at Hidden Chest Studios. 

Our socials are listed here:

Discord: https://discord.gg/Bu96PA9VhZ

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Midwest90_RC

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/midwest90.rapidcity

I really hope you enjoy our alpha demo, we've worked very hard since 2020 on a shoestring budget to bring you our unique vision. But we are far from done, and we would love to receive your feedback.
( If you join our Discord server, you can share your feedback directly with me : )

Thanks for your interest, and we look forward to showing you more of the game in the near future.
